caption:
Eight real places that look like scenes from a winter film. ❄️

📍 Rovaniemi, Finland — aurora above the snow forest.
📍 Shirakawa-go, Japan — traditional farmhouses under a blanket of snow.
📍 Reine, Norway — red cabins beneath Arctic peaks.
📍 Colmar, France — festive lights in the old town.
📍 Jigokudani, Japan — snow monkeys warming up in hot springs.
📍 Tallinn, Estonia — medieval rooftops in the snow.
📍 Lake Louise, Canada — the grand hotel beneath winter mountains.
📍 Québec City, Canada — Château Frontenac rising above the river.

Which winter scene would you travel for?

Photos: Dylan Shaw, Luo Jin Hong, Marianne Gay, Jametlene Reskp, Rogério Toledo, Ilya Orehov, Vincent Y @USA & Lianhao Qu / Unsplash.

#YourTravelAtlas #WinterTravel #WinterEscapes #TravelReels
